about: Hand-worked cases for docs/api-contract.md (D-040), written by build.py, an independent Python reading of the contract that never runs worker/ or src/js/api.js. `worker` cases: send request.method to request.url with an Origin header when request.origin isn't null, to handle(request, env, deps) with env as given and env.POD_CACHE a fake KV per `kv` (null = no binding, "empty", "throws" = get and put reject, or {preset: {key: storedValue}}; get(key, 'json') returns the stored value or null, put records {key, value: JSON.parse(value), ttl: expirationTtl}). deps.fetch answers only the URLs in `upstream` (any other URL fails the test), and must be called with header user-agent = env.USER_AGENT: a {fixture} or {status, contentType, text} entry becomes a Response with that status, content type and body (a fixture's JSON body re-serialized); {reject: true} rejects. Then check status, every header in expect.headers (names lowercase; null in the table means absent: see absentHeaders), the body (JSON.parse, deep-equal; for errors only error.code is compared, and error.message must be a non-empty string), the exact upstream URLs called in order, and the KV puts in order. `seam` cases: call POD.api[fn](...args) in the app's VM ("$" tags: NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -0, undefined; {"$": "D"} is the real POD.data), with POD.config = config when given; compare `returns` (placesFor rows' mi with relative tolerance 1e-9), and for remember compare D and opts afterwards with `after`.
